exports.planProofIndexUpdate: (bytes: Uint8Array, objectFormat: 'sha1' | 'sha256', replacement: { path: 'record/proofs/chain.json'; mode: '100644' | '100755'; oid: string }) => ProofIndexUpdate

snapshot_fields.raw_sha256: SHA256 of exact complete supplied index bytes
snapshot_fields.semantic_sha256: SHA256 of canonical JSON of ordered entries, including path, mode, oid, stage and assume_valid; excludes stat cache and name-length encoding
snapshot_fields.other_entries_sha256: Same digest over entries excluding only record/proofs/chain.json
snapshot_fields.entries: Immutable ordered array of closed {path,mode,oid,stage,assume_valid} entries

update_fields.bytes_base64: Exact complete planned checksummed index bytes as immutable base64 string; no mutable retained Buffer aliases
update_fields.blob_oid: Exact supplied and validated replacement object identity

rules: Pure byte operations only: no filesystem, process, authority grant or actual index/object mutation.

Validate DIRC version2, object-format-specific trailer checksum, complete entry count, supported flags, exact NUL/padding, UTF8 canonical relative paths and byte-order sorting. Refuse malformed/truncated/duplicate/mixed stage0+unmerged entries and unknown extensions/versions.

Support legal other-entry modes 100644,100755,120000,160000 and preserve them exactly; accepting a symlink/gitlink entry in this byte codec grants no source-reader or target-path admission. Refuse sparse-directory representation and extended flags.
Validate TREE extension framing and cache-tree node structure, then invalidate that optional cache on replacement. No unknown extension is dropped silently.

Replace only proof-path stages1/2/3 or its existing stage0 with one stage0 entry; refuse an absent proof entry. New proof entry has zero stat cache and false assume_valid; validate regular mode and exact object-format OID.
Every non-proof entry's original raw bytes and semantic identity remain unchanged. Recompute the complete checksum; independently reparse the planned result and compare all other entries.
Deep-freeze reports/entry arrays. Caller mutation of supplied bytes after return cannot alter the report or planned output.
Canonical JSON sorts object keys by UTF8 byte order, preserves array order and uses compact UTF8 JSON encoding. Git entry ordering uses raw UTF8 path bytes then stage.

Errors use PROOF_INDEX_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED for unsupported but recognizable representations and PROOF_INDEX_INVALID for malformed input; invalid replacement or forbidden proof path uses PROOF_INDEX_REPLACEMENT_REFUSED.
This codec never establishes Owner approval, trusted host identity, a live lock, CAS eligibility, publication durability or readiness. Actual index adapter remains separately required.
required_tests: Actual Git-created regular and linked-worktree unresolved two-path indices; both SHA1 and SHA256 repositories.
One proof entry resolution preserves every other staged/unmerged entry, mode, flag, stat-cache bytes and blob; Git independently reads the planned index in a disposable fixture.
Valid TREE and no-extension cases, variable name lengths and saturated name-length flags.
Wrong proof path, wrong-length/nonhex object identity, absent proof entry and nonregular replacement refuse.
No filesystem change while parsing/planning, immutable outputs and no buffer alias.
